subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp land this narrow all-unmentioned `suppressTyping` mitigation, or wait for the broader visible-delivery typing boundary before changing automatic group typing semantics?
rationale: Both paths can prevent false typing on silent background runs, but only maintainers can accept or reject the tradeoff where proactive visible unmentioned replies lose their typing flash.

options.title: Rebase The Narrow Mitigation
options.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and adapt the predicate to `conversationKind`, group mention metadata, and the command authorization context while keeping focused coverage.

options.title: Prefer Visible Delivery Boundary
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 as the canonical path only after its conflicts and plugin/API compatibility risks are resolved.

options.title: Keep Current Behavior For Now
options.body: Leave automatic unmentioned group turns with their current typing behavior until live repro or UX priority justifies the change.

recommendation.title: Rebase The Narrow Mitigation
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and adapt the predicate to `conversationKind`, group mention metadata, and the command authorization context while keeping focused coverage.
